question: Uttar Pradesh won the 11th Junior National Men’s Hockey Championship following a 3- 1 victory over Chandigarh. Where was the event held?
solution:
The correct answer is **Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Uttar Pradesh Hockey, on 29 May 2022, won the 12th Hockey India Junior Men National Championship by defeating Hockey Chandigarh (2-0) in the final.
 
• The final match was held in Kovilpatti, Tamil Nadu.
 
• Hockey Haryana claimed third place in the competition with a 3-0 win against Hockey Odisha.</span&
